name: Fire Color and Opacity Curves
definition: Remaps grid simulation data to render data. Sim data channel is laid out horizontally along the X axis. Color gradient remaps sim data to fire color. Curve remaps sim data to fire opacity (in Use Own Opacity mode) or fire intensity (otherwise). Opacity/intensity is mapped vertically on the Y axis.
summary: Fire Color and Opacity Curves remap simulation data into fire visuals by explicitly separating color gradient mapping from intensity or opacity curve mapping.
